svg.title: Bazaar.Client: native Avalonia apps built per company
svg.desc: The client is native Avalonia, with one shared Client.Core UI library. Each company builds its own client for each device, with its own interface and modules. Built-in Calcinato is the terminal and CLI, and built-in Athanor is the IDE and text editor. Both can also run standalone to replace the system terminal and text editor.

g.text: Native Avalonia apps, built per company. The repo ships server builds only.
Calcinato and Athanor run inside the client, and also stand alone as the system terminal and text editor.
